The retailer has implemented three solutions developed by the Polish software company.\\nThese are Comarch ERP Standard, Comarch Retail POS , and Comarch WMS .\\nComarch systems are fully integrated with one another, handling enterprise accounting processes, providing sales support, and coordinating warehouse operations.\\nModules comprising Comarch Retail platform have been installed in the chain of 16 Toys “R” US shops in Poland, and at the company’s headquarters, which amounts to almost 100 workstations.\\nThe comprehensive launch of the systems has taken only three months. This is a record-breaking implementation time for Comarch ERP solutions.\\nThree months of very intense work ended in success , says  Maciej Nowak, IT manager at Toys ”R” Us Poland.\\nThe heart of IT solutions supporting the company’s processes is Comarch ERP Standard . The system keeps records of all information on products offered by Toys “R” Us, streamlines the management of customer accounts, and supports purchase processes.\\nIt also analyzes which products are most frequently purchased by customers, and in which months.\\nData are collected and may be used in the future to negotiate with vendors earlier, in order to get the most advantageous conditions. The lower the purchase price, the more attractive the shelf price. The system can configure discounts and promotions for end costumers on the basis of purchase prices.\\nThe Toys “R” Us retail chain comprises more than 64 points of sale . Following the implementation, they have been handled by Comarch Retail POS, which allows comprehensive sales management and the automatic application of personalized offers. Additionally, the software supports promotions, vouchers, and individual discounts granted to clients.\\nEfficient warehouse operations\\nThe project also included the implementation of Comarch WMS, which, in cooperation with Comarch ERP Standard, enables the comprehensive management of a high-bay warehouse . In Poland, there are 16 Toys “R” Us shops. They are supplied by a central warehouse located in Kampinos (the Masovian Voivodeship).\\nSeparate shops handle order policies individually, according to stock level and demand for particular products.\\nEmployees pick orders and send them to a selected shop. The whole process is smooth, as the system collects information on the precise product locations within a warehouse and shares it with warehouse workers.\\nIn total, Comarch WMS is used by 21 warehouse workers, including five employees in the central warehouse and 16 in shops all over Poland.\\nAn additional, unique functionality is the handling of a flow storage ( cross-dock ) warehouse.\"\n      ]\n    },\n    {\n      \"url\": \"https://platform.tracxn.com/a/d/company/59040485e4b0bcc83eed311b/expertwms?utm_source=parallel&utm_medium=ai#a:about\",\n      \"title\": \"ExpertWMS\",\n      \"publish_date\": null,\n      \"excerpts\": [\n        \"Name: ExpertWMS | Website Url: https://expertwms.pl | Primary Sector: Consumer | Primary Subsector: Logistics Tech | Stage: Unfunded | Founded Year: 2011 | Location Country: Poland | Location State: Lesser Poland Voivodeship | Location City: Krakow | Acquisitions As Acquirer Count: 0 | Other Taxonomy Tags: [\\\"Europe Tech\\\",\\\"Enterprise Tech - The retailer has implemented three solutions developed by the Polish software company.\nThese are Comarch ERP Standard, Comarch Retail POS , and Comarch WMS .\nComarch systems are fully integrated with one another, handling enterprise accounting processes, providing sales support, and coordinating warehouse operations.\nModules comprising Comarch Retail platform have been installed in the chain of 16 Toys “R” US shops in Poland, and at the company’s headquarters, which amounts to almost 100 workstations.\nThe comprehensive launch of the systems has taken only three months. This is a record-breaking implementation time for Comarch ERP solutions.\nThree months of very intense work ended in success , says  Maciej Nowak, IT manager at Toys ”R” Us Poland.\nThe heart of IT solutions supporting the company’s processes is Comarch ERP Standard . The system keeps records of all information on products offered by Toys “R” Us, streamlines the management of customer accounts, and supports purchase processes.\nIt also analyzes which products are most frequently purchased by customers, and in which months.\nData are collected and may be used in the future to negotiate with vendors earlier, in order to get the most advantageous conditions. The lower the purchase price, the more attractive the shelf price. The system can configure discounts and promotions for end costumers on the basis of purchase prices.\nThe Toys “R” Us retail chain comprises more than 64 points of sale . Following the implementation, they have been handled by Comarch Retail POS, which allows comprehensive sales management and the automatic application of personalized offers. Additionally, the software supports promotions, vouchers, and individual discounts granted to clients.\nEfficient warehouse operations\nThe project also included the implementation of Comarch WMS, which, in cooperation with Comarch ERP Standard, enables the comprehensive management of a high-bay warehouse . In Poland, there are 16 Toys “R” Us shops.
